page_title: BIL 1-1 VIL | Athletic Bilbao v Villarreal 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Yellow Cards

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Guillermo Cuadra has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+10' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

90+8' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.

90+7' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
90+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Dani Parejo (Villarreal) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Unai Simon into the top left corner.
90+5' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+4' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) was probably a bit loose with his words to Guillermo Cuadra, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Villarreal!

90+2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Villarreal players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+1' Alex Baena (Villarreal) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
83' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick. Free kick. Villarreal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
82' Unai Simon comes off his line to intercept the corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal).
79' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
77' Substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
77' Here is a change. Oihan Sancet is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
75' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) handles the ball inside the penalty area. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.
71' It will be a substitution. Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is ready to enter the pitch as Benat Prados Diaz walks off.
70' A substitution has been made. Nico Williams is replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
69' Guillermo Cuadra sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
69' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alberto Moreno and he is replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal).
69' Substitution. Bertrand Traore walks off the pitch and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
68' Wait! Referee Guillermo Cuadra has indicated he is going to review the Ath Bilbao goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
67' 1 - 0 Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) scores! Gorka Guruzeta heads the ball into his path before he drives in an effort that is too powerful for the goalkeeper to keep out. 1:0.
63' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
61' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul. Villarreal will take a free kick.
60' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Ath Bilbao, play can continue.
60' Referee Guillermo Cuadra makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Ath Bilbao. Let’s see what happens!
59' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

58' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Filip Jorgensen is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
57' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
57' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
55' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Mikel Vesga will be replaced by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
55' Gerard Moreno comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
55' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and signals a foul after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) brought his opponent down. Villarreal are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
52' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
50' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' RED CARD! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Guillermo Cuadra. He can have an early bath.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
41' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.

36' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
35' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Santi Comesana (Villarreal), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
35' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) will miss the next game.
35' Guillermo Cuadra shows the yellow card to Raul Albiol (Villarreal) for a heavy challenge.

34' A short pass finds Bertrand Traore (Villarreal). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
31' The foul by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Guillermo Cuadra.
30' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
29' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes a direct free kick.
29' Bertrand Traore (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.

28' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Inaki Williams, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
26' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal have a free kick.

24' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Filip Jorgensen, who keeps it out.
20' A cross into the box from Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Villarreal.
11' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
11' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
11' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Guillermo Cuadra ignores the protests.
11' It’s a PENALTY to Villarreal after the VAR review!
10' There's a break in play and referee Guillermo Cuadra must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Villarreal using VAR. This could be interesting!
9' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Villarreal for a penalty. Play continues.

9' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
7' Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao in a dangerous position.
6' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
5' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
